text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Green: x1, the fitted table. Light blue: x3, the table copying the network. Each value is the unweighted mean over the 24 speed-ratio and temperature bins of a sector, then over 3 seeds. Anonymised farms W1 to W3.'

unweighted mean over the 24 speed-ratio and temperature bins of a sector, then over 3 seeds.
